verdict.rationale: Metadata preservation or stripping is a fair question for a file-conversion API, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions preserving file metadata (EXIF, document properties, tags) through conversion, or any option to strip it. The file-deletion features only remove files from Zamzar's servers and do not cover metadata handling.

support.subject: As a developer, file metadata is preserved through a conversion or strippable on request
